title: Editing boat details
description: Update your boat's profile, engine, and photo any time.

steps.text: Open the boat hub and tap the pencil (edit) icon.
Change name, make, model, or year.
Edit engine details and attach a photo.

tips: Keep the photo current so boats are easy to tell apart.
affects: Feed the dashboard, intervals, and cost insights.
examples: Correcting a typo in the boat name.
Updating the engine after a repower.
